title: review.json
description: One lecturer's reading of one submission: the remarks, anchored to the student's text or to a rectangle on a photographed page, and the mark per question. It is written by the grading workspace and by the lecturer's own agent through `studio_review`, and **everything an agent writes is a draft**: `state` is set by the route from the door the write came through, never by the writer. A student is served the accepted items and scores, and only once the exercise's `grades.released` is set.

student.description: the `sid`; no key or field under `students/` ever carries an email

scores.description: the mark per question, keyed by the question's id

reviewTarget.description: where the item points: { kind: "text", block, quote? }, { kind: "page", page, rect: [x, y, w, h] with each number between 0 and 1 }, or { kind: "question" }

block.description: the data-id of the block in the typed answer

quote.description: the sentence, so the item survives an edit that moves the block

page.description: the page number within the question, as the submission indexes it

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the page, each between 0 and 1

reviewVia.description: null for a session; { token, label } for an access token; { connector } for the MCP door. The route fills it from the identity

reviewState.description: set by the route: `draft` when `via` is not null, `accepted` for a session's own write or after POST …/review/accept

reviewItem.description: one remark on one question, anchored where it happened

id.description: a ULID minted by the route; a body carrying one that exists updates that item

question.description: the question's id — the data-id of its section in questions.html

body.description: the remark, in the course's language; markdown with $…$ maths

points.description: a delta the lecturer may use or ignore; the number that counts is in `scores`

author.description: the actor who wrote it; the route fills it

reviewScore.description: one question's mark; the total is the sum of the accepted ones

points.description: null is "not marked yet"; the route refuses to release while one is missing
